description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointID component, testing its methods for decoding and normalizing service names, handling non-service endpoints, and decoding Bonjour escape sequences within gateway endpoint identifiers.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointIDTests
classes.description: Test suite for GatewayEndpointID functionality, verifying ID decoding, normalization, and escape sequence decoding.

methods.name: stableIDForServiceDecodesAndNormalizesName
methods.description: Tests that GatewayEndpointID correctly decodes and normalizes service names with escaped characters.

methods.name: stableIDForNonServiceUsesEndpointDescription
methods.description: Tests that GatewayEndpointID uses the endpoint's description for non-service endpoints.

methods.name: prettyDescriptionDecodesBonjourEscapes
methods.description: Verifies that GatewayEndpointID correctly decodes Bonjour escape sequences in endpoint descriptions.
